entries.title: II John 1:1
segments:
The elder. The apostle John.
 

 
 Elect lady. It is not certain whether an individual or a church is meant.
 

 
 Children. Members of a church, if the latter meaning be taken.
 

 
 Truth. The Christian teaching and practice, according to John and the other apostles.

entries.title: II John 1:3
segments: Grace, mercy, peace. For a similar formula of salutation, see

entries.title: II John 1:8
segments: Look to yourselves, etc.  A warning to the disciples against false teachers who were endeavoring to undermine the Christian faith as taught by the apostles.

entries.title: II John 1:9
segments:
Onward. Away from the Christian truth revealed and taught.
 

 
 He that abideth. He who habitually does the will of God as revealed in Christ.

entries.title: II John 1:10
segments: Receive him not, etc.  Show no hospitality to him who would insidiously beguile you away from your faith in Christ.

entries.title: II John 1:13
segments: Elect sister. Either an individual or a church.  See
